title: MapleStory M July 8/9, 2026 Patch Notes
original_title: 07.08/09 Patch Notes (Tutorial & Adventure Mission, Main UI Improvements, Star Force Field Improvements, Crystal Treasure Box Secondary Weapon x3 Event)
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: The July 8/9 update revised the main UI and quest tabs, improved tutorial and Adventure Mission flows, corrected Sol Erda party drops, adjusted Star Force Field party play, and introduced account-link, treasure-box, and package events.

sections.title: Interface and quest changes
items: Character, combat power, location, party, and map information were reorganized in the main interface.
Quest access was split into To Do, Event, and Miyo's Boost Mission tabs.
Content and Auto-Battle progress can replace quest information while those activities are running.

sections.title: Hunting and progression
items: Sol Erda Fragments and Sol Erda Energy can drop from monsters defeated by party members using the player's own Item Drop Rate.
The update includes party-hunting and Star Force Field improvements.
Tutorial and Adventure Mission presentation and guidance were revised.

sections.title: Events and sales
items: A PC MapleStory and MapleStory M account-link event runs after the July 9 update through August 26, 2026.
A Crystal Treasure Box event raises the secondary-weapon rate during its stated event window.
The notice includes several time-limited ticket, crystal, enhancement, and custom packages.

notes: Original MPStorys summary and structured facts verified against the official Nexon Forum patch note on 2026-07-25.
changes: Reorganized the main UI and introduced To Do, Event, and Miyo's Boost Mission quest tabs.
Made Sol Erda drops available from party-member kills using the player's own Item Drop Rate.
Improved tutorial, Adventure Mission, party hunting, and Star Force Field flows.
Added the Maple M Account Link Event and Crystal Treasure Box Secondary Weapon x3 Event.
resolved_issues: Fixed Sol Erda Fragments and Sol Erda Energy not dropping from monsters defeated by party members.
